create_coco_results_from_gt: create COCO format result files from ground truth annotations and a targets file
create_perfect_gt_results: create perfect ground truth results with score 1.0 for all target images in a dataset
filter_coco_annotations_by_targets: filter COCO annotations to include only those matching scene and image IDs from a targets file
validate_coco_results_format: validate that generated COCO results JSON passes the segmentation annotation format check
save_coco_results_json: save filtered ground truth COCO results as a JSON file to the specified results path
